title: The Strange Power of Fake Medicine
hook: Every time you take medicine, your brain might respond by healing you alone.
script: Every time you take medicine, your brain might respond by healing you alone. Can a fake treatment trick your body into making its own real painkiller? When patients take a fake placebo pill, their spine releases real painkilling chemicals. Blocking those natural chemicals with another drug instantly brought the pain back. In fake knee surgeries where doctors made incisions without operating, patients healed just as well. Two fake pills work better than one, and branded sugar pills outperform generic ones. Your brain is already manufacturing the cure before any pill ever touches your tongue.
